caption: The drawing depicts a decorative lamp or lantern with a spherical glass body and ornate metalwork. The top section consists of two dome-shaped, scalloped metal covers stacked one above the other, crowned with a small finial. The central spherical body is divided vertically by metal bands and horizontally by a wide decorative band with cut-out patterns and a central rosette or flower ornament. The glass of the sphere has a detailed pattern of leaves etched or drawn on it. On either side of the horizontal band, there are symmetrical, shell-like or petal-shaped ornaments protruding outward. At the bottom, a cylindrical metal base supports the sphere, featuring small round holes near the edge and a downward-extending cylindrical stem. The overall color of the drawing is grayscale, using variations of black, white, and gray for shading and details. An inset box in the lower right corner provides a close-up view of the leaf pattern repeated on the lantern’s glass. The background is plain and unadorned.
title: Garden Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
